key_insight: Damocles already integrates the best free source (Sentinel Hub CDSE). The primary gap is: (1) adding Sentinel-2 optical change detection alongside the existing S1 SAR vessel detection, and (2) adding Landsat thermal anomaly detection. Both are free, no-key, and fit the existing sensor architecture.
recommended_next_steps: Extend GeospatialSensor to also fetch Sentinel-2 optical via existing CDSE auth
Add NDWI computation (one numpy expression) for Evros water level monitoring
Add Landsat TIRS thermal band via USGS STAC for fire/activity detection
Apply for Planet Labs Education Program (3 weeks approval, daily 3m imagery)
